files.content:
# Shop

A small order service built with Spring Boot: place orders, look them up, and refund them in full or in part.

## Run

Start PostgreSQL on localhost:5432 with a `shop` database, then:

    mvn spring-boot:run

Flyway creates the schema on startup.

## API

- `GET /orders/{id}` returns one order.
- `POST /orders/{id}/refund` with `{"amount": 10.00}` refunds part of a paid order. The total refunded can never exceed what the customer paid.

spring:
  application:
    name: shop
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/shop
    username: ${DB_USERNAME:shop}
    # Fake credential, on purpose: the analyzer must redact it before storing or embedding this file.
    password: <REDACTED:password>
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false

shop:
  refunds:
    max-days-after-purchase: 30
  payment:
    api-key: ${PAYMENT_API_KEY}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>4.1.2</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>shop</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>shop</name>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc</artifactId>
        </dependency>

            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-flyway</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-database-postgresql</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>
